title: Unit-testing one constraint at a time

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: blind_spot.py ran the whole-model test with each of five broken rules, on GridCap tiny and on GridCap small. How many broken rules passed it?

options.text: Two passed on tiny, and none of them passed on small
options.says: The table shows three PASS lines on tiny and one on small.

options.text: Three passed on tiny, and one of them passed on small
options.says: Right: on small only the row that adds 1 to the lag still passed.

options.text: Three passed on tiny, and all three passed on small
options.says: On small, the ignored lag and the one-year alternatives row changed the plan and failed.

options.text: One passed on tiny, and three of them passed on small
options.says: The table shows three PASS lines on tiny and one on small.

origin.section: A Whole-Model Test Can Pass With a Broken Rule

questions.stem: A unit test calls accepts with a start in a year outside the project's window, a year the model has no variable for. What does accepts do?

options.text: It returns False before solving, so that plan is refused
options.says: Right: a start with no variable is refused outright.

options.text: It skips that start and solves for the rest of the plan
options.says: Skipping it would test some other plan than the one asked about; the lesson refuses it.

options.text: It adds a variable for that year, then solves the plan
options.says: accepts adds nothing to the model; it returns False when a start has no variable.

options.text: It raises KeyError, since x has no entry for that year
options.says: accepts checks for the missing key first and returns False.

origin.section: Fix the Plan, Then Ask the Solver: Allowed or Refused

questions.stem: one_rule.py ran the five one-rule unit tests against the correct rules and the five broken copies. Which unit test passed in every column?

options.text: test_budget_caps_every_year, as no bug touches the budget rule
options.says: It failed on bug 1, the budget row that skips the last year.

options.text: test_at_most_one_alternative, as no bug touches that rule
options.says: It failed on bug 4, the alternatives row that counts one year.

options.text: test_a_project_starts_at_most_once, as no bug touches that rule
options.says: Right: no bug changes the once rule, so it passes everywhere.

options.text: test_must_do_is_always_funded, as no bug touches that rule
options.says: It failed on bug 2, the must-do row written with <=.

origin.section: Pair Every Refused Plan With an Allowed One, at the Boundary
